title: Hunts FH-036: Bind Experience Pass to Event ticket tier

source.ref: Frequency Hunts Build Plan (9 Nov 2026), Tier 4, Checkout. Owner asked 2026-11-09 to build the program into the site.

detail: Configure immutable tier benefit codes, canonical price and seats, purchase origin and attendee claim. Done when: Unauthenticated callback, forged price, wrong tier and unclaimed guest email cannot open benefit. Requires: FH-031, FH-035. Owner role: Events and billing.
